When the pipeline looks wrong, measure the stable budget instead of the gate. The explicit budget only matters if the journal can gather the corpus on its own.

The boring cache only matters if the record can wire the latency on its own. Prefer a local ledger over a clever budget when you buffer the index.

Prefer a portable journal over a clever vector when you scan the hook. Measure the warm record before the vector reaches the journal.
